initialization: fresh native random initialization; no probe checkpoint reuse
precision: CUDA native bfloat16 autocast; float32 weights, gradients and AdamW moments; no GradScaler

data.shuffle: CPU torch.randperm over all windows, seed 160; one permutation; no epoch wrap

selected_checkpoint: last completed update 7485, only if run and fixed quality gates pass
prerequisites_before_any_training: Separate explicit owner Phase 17 start after approved verified Phase 16 publication.
Full-corpus reader/cache and final partial accumulation must pass target conservation, identity, token-weighted gradient and recovery tests before any optimizer update.
Full-data cache must reproduce the Phase 16 window sequence hash and all token counts.
Original Phase 5 base and required evaluation inputs must be available with pinned hashes on the evaluation host; missing artifacts block scoring, never substitute a random model.
Capture environment, freeze source/runtime/input identities and source snapshot; preserve existing artifacts.
stop_conditions: Nonfinite loss, gradients, weights or optimizer state: retain failure and stop; no retry of numerical failure.
OOM, >85% reserved VRAM, >8 GiB host RSS, >20 GiB new artifacts, or wall budget reached: save only a valid completed boundary when possible, retain evidence and stop.
Identity, corruption, split, target or recovery mismatch: fail closed.
Unexpected external interruption: at most two restores of exact completed checkpoint and same configuration/runtime; log repeated/lost exposure separately; never count it as new unique data.
Fixed development or final acceptance failure: preserve negative result and block Phase 18; no tuning from final feedback.
evaluation: Use unchanged configs/evaluation/protocol-v1.json and docs/EVALUATION.md. Pair historical base on same host/backend/batching. Matched BPB across tokenizers, not raw token perplexity. Lock final candidate only after all development gates; one final comparison under frozen access policy. No reserved access for routine monitoring.
limitation: Full-corpus duration and quality are unmeasured; budget is a bounded first full-data run, not a quality prediction. No Phase 17 model initialized or trained during planning.
